name: review
description: Review code with code-reviewer persona and security-auditor persona for multi-axis quality check

steps.prompt: Load the code-review-and-quality skill and code-reviewer agent persona
Review code using the five-axis framework: correctness, maintainability, performance, security, operability. Classify each finding as Blocker/Major/Minor/Praise
Load security-auditor persona. Perform OWASP Top 10 assessment on the code changes. Check for common vulnerabilities: injection, XSS, broken auth, IDOR
Reference security-checklist.md and accessibility-checklist.md for additional review dimensions
Summarize findings: list blockers that must be fixed before merge, majors that should be fixed, and minors for improvement
